Name: Voru Cinderveil
Ability effect: I Pull an enemy within $mt_distance[4] up to $mt_distance[3]. For each hex pulled, I give my nearest ally 1 Enraged.
Notes: TEST: nearest living other ally is measured from me after each actual Pull step; I choose distance ties. Blocked or skipped steps grant no token. An enemy defeated by a hazard ends Pull.

Name: Demea Lastbanner
Ability effect: My adjacent allies have Heavy Attack(2).
Notes: Live aura while active: other adjacent allies gain Heavy Attack (2). Begins when paid; expires at my next activation start or defeat. One active instance; evaluate adjacency at the roll boundary.

Name: Ilex Marchstep
Ability effect: I move another adjacent ally up to $mt_distance[3], then I move up to $mt_distance[3].
Notes: Both movements optional and independent of paid-action counters; if the ally is defeated by movement hazards, I may still move if alive.

Name: Tavi Sailwhistle
Ability effect: Each time a Recruit ends their movement adjacent to an enemy this turn, I draw a Tactic card.
Notes: TEST: paid activation lasts through this friendly turn only. Friendly Recruits only; once per completed voluntary movement, not per traversed hex. No trigger on forced movement, swap, deployment or respawn. Repeated activation does not multiply the trigger.

Name: Orro Stormanchor
Ability effect: Push up to two adjacent enemies up to $mt_distance[2] each, then give them each 1 Dazed.

Name: Hester Wellward
Ability effect: I move up to $mt_distance[3] in a straight line, then each adjacent ally gains 2 Fortified.
Notes: I may move zero. Adjacent allies excludes me; evaluate after movement. Resolve terrain after every step.

Name: Perrin Lastdrop
Ability effect: I gain 2 Enraged. While I have Enraged, other adjacent allies gain +1 Attack die.
Notes: Conditional passive checks my current Enraged stack and adjacency at the roll boundary; the bonus is +1.

Name: Bisti Grasshade
Ability effect: I make a {Moonfall/icons/ranged.webp} 3($mt_distance[3]) with Heavy Attack(2). I must target an enemy which has none of my allies adjacent to it.
Notes: Current identity-correct portrait: assets/heroes/current. Ability attack uses its fixed dice and range with ordinary ranged penalties. Its tactic payment matches the assigned element.

Name: Niala Grassveil
Ability effect: I move another ally within $mt_distance[3] up to $mt_distance[2], then give one enemy adjacent to that ally 1 Dazed.
